# Synthetic sample

**Not operational observations.** Generated by `scripts/generate_sample.py`, model v0.1.0, Python 3.12, SimPy 4.1.2. Fixed workload seed 17; default 18 arrivals/hour, lognormal means 6/7 minutes with CV .5, two pickers and two packers, eight hours, no break or initial backlog. Start 2026-01-05T08:00:00+00:00. End 16:00:00+00:00. Only observed endpoints by cutoff are written; blank endpoints represent unfinished stages. Worker identities are intentionally absent: source engine models homogeneous pools.

One row per released order; starts/ends come from the simulation trace. No real WMS, customer or worker data is included. A selected seed is one illustration, not a validation dataset. The simulation comparison uses its separately declared assumptions and seeds, not inferred active service durations from this sample. Regenerate from the repository root with `python scripts/generate_sample.py` after installing the project for development.
